title: Fixes from the 1.27.0 review
problem: The 1.27.0 review found a one-phone hand-over gap, wrong prices on the Daily card on Fixed prices days, and words and screens that disagree with the game.
scope: A-01 one-phone hand-over: block input until the hand-over is tapped
A-02 the Daily card's prices on Fixed prices days
A-03 to A-08 League lines, names, the $9 star becomes $8, the level per rival; Best day as the net change; missed order on the one-phone note
B-01 to B-05, B-07, B-08 lobby names, reaction button placement and size, dialog focus, free-seat invite words, contrast, text size
Polish A-10 to A-14 and B-09 to B-17
B-06 the online "First time? How to play" text: no exclamation marks, and the first buyer worded as the game's own tip (owner: "yes to 2")
exclusions: No rule, balance or protocol change (Uncle Benny's level is PLAN-117)
